Also: The moved docstring keeps ATLAS-side text from WantedExt/Combinatorics/BinaryChvatalSankoffWanted.lean that Formal-Math does not have yet (its backport is still owed). Restate docstrings to match the Lean statements (Atlas wiki audit, #988).
